Terms of Use

Plain-language terms governing pc.am, MIT-licensed PCoin open-source software, and project-operated web services. Last updated 18 November 2026.

1. Open-source software (“as is”)

PCoin Core, PCoin Wallet, the Windows and Linux miners, and the Stratum pool software are free, open-source software released under the MIT License. All software and documentation on pc.am are provided “as is”, without warranty of any kind, express or implied, including merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, or uninterrupted availability.

2. Experimental blockchain — not an investment

PCoin (PCN) is a young, experimental proof-of-work Layer-1 blockchain launched in August 2026. PCN is not an investment, security, deposit, or financial product, and nothing on pc.am or project channels is financial, legal, or tax advice. There is no guaranteed market price, liquidity, or buyback: order books on exchange.pc.am and liquidity pools for wrapped wPCN are small and thin, and any trade can move the price significantly.

3. Non-custodial responsibility for keys & transactions

When using PCoin non-custodial wallets or nodes, you alone control your private keys and 12-word or 24-word recovery phrase. Nobody maintaining PCoin has access to your wallet, can recover a lost recovery phrase, or can reverse, cancel, or modify a blockchain transaction once broadcast. Always verify destination addresses, network selection (native PCoin pc1? / P? vs BNB Smart Chain wPCN), and SHA-256 binary checksums before sending funds.

4. Project web services & acceptable use

Optional services operated by the project — including pool.pc.am, market.pc.am, exchange.pc.am, and wrapdesk.pc.am — publish their current fees, minimums, caps, and manual settlement windows on their own pages. We may pause a service, cap order sizes, or suspend accounts engaging in abuse, self-trading/wash volume, exploit attempts, or unlawful conduct. You are solely responsible for complying with the laws, regulations, and tax obligations of your jurisdiction.

5. Contact

Reach the maintainer at pcoin@pc.am or open an issue on github.com/pars5555/pcoin.
